title: Kushki — DP-4303 invalid card BIN (K006 DFR029): swap to the Kushki Visa test card
symptom: Kushki rejected the purchase with DP-4303 (HTTP 422) because the card BIN is invalid (K006 DFR029 - Bin de tarjeta inválido). The configured Kushki test card BIN is rejected by the PSP, preventing the prerequisite purchase, so the order is never created and the test fails validating that the order was processed successfully.
recipe: Test-data fix, not a product bug: Kushki staging no longer accepts the BIN of the test card in use (mostly kushkiMasterCardExitosa / 5451951574925480). Swap it for the Kushki Visa test card `kushkiVisaSuccessfull` (4168818844447115, exp 11/27, cvv 123) from `@support/interfaces/credit_cards`. Confirmed: swapping ADM-T471 to it passes against staging. Change ONLY the card used for the Kushki purchase; keep processor, amounts and assertions. (1) When the spec passes a card object (e.g. `fillCreditCardDataDeunaNow(creditCardData.kushkiMasterCardExitosa, ...)`), replace it with `creditCardData.kushkiVisaSuccessfull`. (2) When the card is a hardcoded literal in a purchase payload (`card_number: '5451951574925480'` in the spec, in a `const creditCard = {...}`, or in a shared helper such as `teams/admin/orders/share/filterOrderByEmail.ts`), do NOT paste the new number as a literal. Import `* as creditCardData from '@support/interfaces/credit_cards'` if it is missing and reference `creditCardData.kushkiVisaSuccessfull.number` and `.cvv_code`. Take expiry from its `expiration_date` ('1127' → expiry_month '11', expiry_year '2027'), which also replaces expired literals such as expiry_year '2025'. The proposal must mention `kushkiVisaSuccessfull` by name or heal rejects it as ungrounded before verify. Do not use this recipe when the test is about a specific card brand/type (e.g. a debit Mastercard case) or when the DP-4303 comes from a PSP other than Kushki.
